turns.assessment: The degradation pattern is confined to SNCP services associated with S23, consistent with impairment of their shared protection transport rather than svc209's normal S14-S04-S08-S23 working route. On S13->S01, all three amplifiers show an approximately 5.2 dB input and output reduction, including the booster input, followed by reduced channel power and OSNR at S01 and degraded och32 reception at S15. This localizes the loss ahead of the S13 booster; unchanged pump currents and equal input/output reductions argue strongly against an amplifier fault, while the partial all-channel loss fits a dirty OMS input connector rather than a pulled connector or WSS port failure.

proposals.rationale: A contaminated patch between the S13 ROADM degree and the S13->S01 booster would reduce every channel before amp0. It directly explains the equal ~5.2 dB drop at the inputs and outputs of all amplifiers, downstream channel-power/OSNR loss, and och32 quality degradation.
